        }

// Copyright (c) Microsoft. All rights reserved.

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;

public abstract class Block : ITextRendering
{
    protected readonly ILogger _logger;
    protected readonly string Content;

    protected Block(string? content, ILoggerFactory? loggerFactory = null)
    {
        this.Content = content ?? string.Empty;
        this._logger = loggerFactory?.CreateLogger<Block>() ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(loggerFactory));
    }

    public abstract BlockTypes Type { get; }

    public abstract object? Render(KernelArguments? arguments);

    protected ILogger Logger => this._logger;
}
